observations.text: The duty log for last Thursday — an entry has been torn out cleanly. The time stub remains: 9:40 PM.
observations.journal_entry: Webb removed an entry from the official duty log for Thursday evening. Whatever he recorded — or was called to — has been deliberately erased.

observations.text: Beneath the desk blotter: a folded ten-pound banknote. Fresh-printed. Considerably more than a constable's weekly wage.
observations.journal_entry: A ten-pound note concealed under Webb's desk blotter. Part of a larger payment, or simply greed made visible.

observations.text: An unsealed envelope in the waste basket, addressed to 'E.H.' at Harrington Manor. The letter inside has been removed.
observations.journal_entry: Webb began a letter to someone at the Harrington manor, then thought better of sending it. The initial 'E.H.' is ambiguous — Edmund, or Eleanor?
